description: Use for 'can I go / work / stay in X with a Y passport' questions — e.g. 'Slovakia to Thailand visa', 'US citizen digital nomad visa Japan', 'do Indian passport holders need a visa for Georgia'. Give the passport country and destination (ISO-3166 code or English name), optional `visa_type` keyword filter (e.g. 'digital nomad', 'work', 'tourist') and `max_alternatives` (0–20). Returns the best-matching visa option, ranked alternatives, source, passport-specificity flag, and a concise recommendation. Each option carries `official_link` and `data_as_of` (the date the row was last loaded, not a check of the rule; null when undated). For the detailed requirements/documents of a specific route use get_visa_requirements.

destination_country.description: Country being travelled to: ISO-3166 alpha-2/alpha-3 code or English name, e.g. 'TH', 'THA', 'Thailand'.

max_alternatives.description: How many alternative visa options to return after the best match (0-20, default 5).

passport_country.description: Country of the traveller's passport: ISO-3166 alpha-2/alpha-3 code or English name, e.g. 'SK', 'SVK', 'Slovakia'.

visa_type.description: Keyword filter on the visa type, e.g. 'digital nomad', 'work', 'visa_free'. Omit to get every option on file.

name: visa_check
title: Check visa options for a route
